historical_blocker.mechanism: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs returns 302 to a SIGNED Azure Blob Storage URL (productionresultssa4.blob.core.windows.net). urllib's default redirect handler re-sends the Authorization: Bearer header to that host. Azure rejects a signed request that also carries an Authorization header, returning HTTP 401 'Server failed to authenticate the request. Please refer to the information in the www-authenticate header'. transport.py maps any 401 to AuthenticationError, so a redirect bug is reported as a GitHub credential failure.
proof: Same token, same endpoint, same session: the only variable is whether Authorization survives the cross-host redirect.
historical_blocker.environment_independent: GitHub always redirects job logs to blob storage, so this fails wherever the resolver runs, including CI. It is not specific to this sandbox.
historical_blocker.fix: Strip the Authorization header when a redirect crosses to a different host (what requests and curl do by default). A ~6-line HTTPRedirectHandler subclass in transport.py.
historical_blocker.state: RESOLVED — fixed on main at 57cf94e (#52). Retained because this receipt is the record that identified it.
